whyServiceNow.title: Why ServiceNow's ISV Partner Operations
narrative: I've already been inside the ServiceNow ecosystem. At Accenture—ServiceNow's Global Elite Partner across reseller, service provider, consultant, implementation, and build—I saw firsthand how powerful the partner model is when operations run tight. I supported processes that rolled up to the very partnerships ServiceNow relies on to scale.

ServiceNow's ISV partner strategy is the creator economy at enterprise scale. Just like hyperscalers (AWS, Azure) provide infrastructure for builders, ServiceNow provides the Now Platform for ISVs to build, test, and sell applications. The ISV Lighthouse Initiative with Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Essentia proves ServiceNow isn't just enabling partners—it's orchestrating an ecosystem.

Here's what I bring that's unique: I don't just manage pipelines—I understand the dynamics of partner-driven revenue models. Partners aren't employees. They have their own quotas, their own motivations, and their own challenges. Managing partner productivity means understanding what drives them, building transparent performance metrics, and creating win-win incentive structures.

I've led territory redesigns (15 territories, 20K+ accounts), managed compensation plans, and owned forecast accuracy for global revenue calls. At Camunda, I built Clari dashboards that became the single source of truth for our CRO and VP of Sales. At Pinterest via Accenture, I supported earnings call preparation—I know what it means to operate in a publicly traded company where every quarter matters.

ServiceNow's partner operations need someone who can be an internal consultant, a data storyteller, and a strategic orchestrator. Someone who can break silos between Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Legal. Someone who can turn rocket science into actionable insights that busy executives can actually use. That's exactly what I do.
